value.rationale: The source fixed-α large-distance mean scale x^{2α} and α→0 fixed-distance extreme-rate limit motivate exponential targets x=exp(b/α) and their sharp crossover. The theorem characterizes the full joint law over arbitrary finitely many scales, reveals new independent increments despite sharing noise and environment, specifies jump-size intensities, covariance, and both outer phase boundaries. These structural predictions are useful for coupled first-passage simulation and cannot be recovered from a single-time marginal or the known α→0 fixed-rate half-mass observation. Restrictions to the stated continuous-space model and noninterchangeability of expectations are explicit.
